children.prompt: Complete the following using the number lines above.

answer.worked:
The first quarter tick aligns with the second eighth, third twelfth and fourth sixteenth ticks.
$$\frac14=\frac28=\frac3{12}=\frac4{16}$$

The fourth eighth tick is halfway between $0$ and $1$. It aligns with the sixth twelfth and eighth sixteenth ticks.
$$\frac12=\frac48=\frac6{12}=\frac8{16}$$

The third twelfth tick aligns with the first quarter, second eighth and fourth sixteenth ticks.
$$\frac14=\frac28=\frac3{12}=\frac4{16}$$

The fifth eighth tick aligns with the tenth sixteenth tick.
$$\frac58=\frac{10}{16}$$

The endpoint $1$ is the fourth quarter, eighth eighth, twelfth twelfth and sixteenth sixteenth tick.
$$\frac44=\frac88=\frac{12}{12}=\frac{16}{16}$$

The fourteenth sixteenth tick aligns with the seventh eighth tick.
$$\frac78=\frac{14}{16}$$
